priorityList: Charge into combat and use Pummel to interrupt spellcasting.
Use Avatar on cooldown, ideally synchronized with other major offensive abilities.
Cast Colossus Smash on cooldown to maintain its damage vulnerability on the target.
Use Bladestorm only while the Colossus Smash debuff is active on the target.
Cast Champion's Spear while Colossus Smash or Avatar is active to maximize damage.
Use Ravager when Colossus Smash has 1.5 seconds or less remaining on its cooldown.
Use Execute whenever Sudden Death procs, regardless of target health.
During Execute Phase (target below 20% or 35% health), cast Mortal Strike if you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision or Colossus Smash is up.
During Execute Phase, cast Execute if you have more than 40 Rage.
During Execute Phase, use Overpower to generate Rage and build Executioner's Precision stacks.
Maintain the Rend bleed on the target, refreshing it when there are 5 seconds or less remaining.
Cast Mortal Strike on cooldown as your primary damage dealer outside of Execute Phase.
Cast Overpower to buff your next Mortal Strike or Execute.
Use Wrecking Throw if it is available and you have no higher priority actions.
Use Slam as your final filler if you have excess Rage and all other abilities are on cooldown.
